## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools

- **Date:** 2026-05-19  
  **Link:** [Google: Gemini 3.5](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/gemini-3-5/)  
  **Summary:** Google announced Gemini 3.5, positioning it as a frontier model with stronger action-oriented capabilities.  
  **Why it matters:** Google is tying frontier-model progress directly to agentic execution across its consumer, developer, and Workspace surfaces.

- **Date:** 2026-05-19  
  **Link:** [Google: I/O 2026 agentic Gemini era](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/sundar-pichai-io-2026/)  
  **Summary:** Google framed I/O 2026 around an “agentic Gemini era,” with AI embedded across Search, Workspace, subscriptions, and developer tooling.  
  **Why it matters:** The strategic signal is platform-wide integration, not a single-model launch.

- **Date:** 2026-05-19  
  **Link:** [Google Developers Blog: Antigravity CLI transition](https://developers.googleblog.com/an-important-update-transitioning-gemini-cli-to-antigravity-cli/)  
  **Summary:** Google is transitioning Gemini CLI into Antigravity CLI, adding shared agent harnesses, subagents, hooks, skills, plugins, and async multi-agent workflows. Individual/free Gemini CLI and Gemini Code Assist request serving ends June 18, 2026; enterprise access remains supported.  
  **Why it matters:** Google is consolidating coding agents around a more explicit multi-agent developer platform.

- **Date:** 2026-05-19  
  **Link:** [TechCrunch: Gemini Spark](https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/19/google-introduces-gemini-spark-a-24-7-agentic-assistant-with-gmail-integration/)  
  **Summary:** Google introduced Gemini Spark, described as an always-on personal agent with Gmail, Docs, Workspace, Chrome, and MCP-connected integrations. It is reportedly in internal testing and expected for Google AI Ultra subscribers next week.  
  **Why it matters:** This moves consumer agents from chat sessions toward persistent, account-level task execution.

- **Date:** 2026-05-19  
  **Link:** [TechCrunch: Gemini Omni](https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/19/googles-gemini-omni-turns-images-audio-and-text-into-video-and-thats-just-the-start/)  
  **Summary:** Google introduced Gemini Omni, a multimodal model family for reasoning across text, image, audio, and video, including video generation and text-directed image edits.  
  **Why it matters:** Cross-modal generation is becoming a primary frontier-model battleground.

- **Date:** 2026-05-19  
  **Link:** [Google: AI Search](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/search-io-2026/)  
  **Summary:** Google announced a new AI Search push, including broader AI Mode positioning in U.S. search.  
  **Why it matters:** Search distribution remains Google’s main AI leverage point; AI Mode adoption directly affects publisher traffic, ad formats, and user query behavior.

- **Date:** 2026-05-19  
  **Link:** [Google: Workspace updates](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/workspace/workspace-updates/)  
  **Summary:** Google announced new AI capabilities for Workspace.  
  **Why it matters:** Enterprise productivity remains one of the most monetizable AI surfaces.

- **Date:** 2026-05-19  
  **Link:** [OpenAI: ChatGPT Images 2.0](https://openai.com/zh-Hans-CN/index/introducing-chatgpt-images-2-0/)  
  **Summary:** OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Images 2.0, citing improved text rendering, multilingual support, and visual reasoning. Help Center material indicates availability across ChatGPT plans, with “images with thinking” for Plus, Pro, and Business.  
  **Why it matters:** Image generation is shifting from novelty output toward controllable visual reasoning and text-faithful production.

- **Date:** 2026-05-18  
  **Link:** [OpenAI: Codex with Dell](https://openai.com/index/openai-and-dell-technologies-partner-to-bring-codex-to-hybrid-and-on-premises-enterprise-environments/)  
  **Summary:** OpenAI and Dell announced a partnership to bring Codex to hybrid and on-premises enterprise environments.  
  **Why it matters:** OpenAI is adapting agentic coding to regulated and data-sensitive enterprise deployments that cannot rely only on public cloud workflows.

- **Date:** 2026-05-18  
  **Link:** [TechCrunch: SandboxAQ models in Claude](https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/18/sandboxaq-brings-its-drug-discovery-models-to-claude-no-phd-in-computing-required/)
